strengths: All required files for the requirement step were generated comprehensively, covering 14 functional modules with clear P0-P3 priority distinctions.

User review score of 0.88 (4.4/5) significantly exceeded the minimum threshold of 0.7, indicating high stakeholder approval.
mistakes: Inaccurate line count for architecture.md (899 vs. 849) in summary.md led to file content inconsistency.
Decision status for JWT Token storage location was mismatched between PRD (pending) and summary.md (localStorage), causing record inconsistency.

takeaways: Cross-check document metadata like line counts against actual files to prevent factual errors in summaries.
Establish a centralized decision log or automated sync process to keep decision records consistent across all documents.
Implement a feedback tracking matrix or explicit logging system in PRDs to ensure all user suggestions are recorded with clear disposition status.
